title: Strong monoidality of the standard derived localization equivalence
statement: For any scheme X [def-pc-scheme] with a chosen derived localization [def-pc-derived-category], the functor of schemeDerivedStandardEquivalence X [def-pc-derived-pullback-across-universes] admits a CoreMonoidal structure for the fixed K-flat derived tensor structures [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. This asserts existence only; the unit and tensor comparison maps are invertible and satisfy the monoidal coherence laws. No hypothesis on X is required.

source.place: Stacks Project, Tags 079U (identity morphism), 05RU (localization); derived.tex for Tag 05RU

proof.text: Specialize the fixed sheaf tensor, its closedness and symmetry, the Grothendieck structure, and schemeModule_hasFunctorialFlatResolution. The abstract comparison uses inferInstanceAs for the derived monoidal structures, matching the construction in schemeDerivedTensorMonoidal without changing it.

For the quasi-isomorphism property W on cochain complexes, choose a flat left resolution inside the proof and apply the upstream isLocalizedEquivalence_of_functorial_left_resolutions to its reduced kFlatResolutionNatTrans. Thus the K-flat inclusion followed by Q is a localization at W.WKFlat. The quotientCompQhIso and associator identify it with J followed by Qh. The same reduced resolution supplies the K-flat left derivability structure on the homotopy category.

For either chosen derived localization, J followed by toDerivedMonoidal is strong monoidal: its tensor comparison is invertible by DerivedMonoidal.isIso_counit_app_app_of_kFlat_left, since every object of J is K-flat, and its unit comparison is invertible. Use Functor.Monoidal.ofLaxMonoidal to package this construction.

The canonical Localization.compUniqFunctor identifies J followed by Qh followed by the specified equivalence with J followed by the standard Qh. Apply Mathlib Localization.Monoidal.functorCoreMonoidalOfComp to this lifting along the strong monoidal K-flat localization. This constructs the required CoreMonoidal structure with all coherence laws.

mathlib_searches.results: Ordinary monoidal localization structures only; no theorem for the fixed K-flat derived tensor or the specified localization equivalence.
inverseMonoidal transports a known monoidal structure to the inverse equivalence; it does not provide the initial structure or the left-derived comparison.

Mathlib ordinary monoidal localization functorMonoidalOfComp requires strong monoidal localization, whereas Qh is only lax monoidal. Repository rg found no interface for standard derived equivalence monoidality or across-universes left-derived comparison.
